note: The early Swedish Monopol board with Stockholm streets, issued in 1937 by Åhlén & Åkerlunds förlag (Nordiska museet / DigitaltMuseum, id 021028370534). The museum describes it as probably the first Swedish edition and estimates production to 1937–1938. boardPrice is the printed purchase price in game currency, read from that board (KR.1000–KR.8000); the GO square says salary KR.4000 when passing. For Hornsgatan, Götgatan, Odengatan, Karlavägen, Kungsgatan and Drottninggatan, realToday is the rounded median kr/m² among listed apartment sales in calendar year 2025 (Hemnet for the first three streets; Booli for the latter three). Strandvägen is the published street-level mean for sales April 2025–March 2026 from Svensk Mäklarstatistik. Norrmalmstorg has no registered apartment sales and therefore uses the rounded 12-month mean for the wider Vasastan–Norrmalm area, updated July 2026. The chart labels this value as an area proxy.
